tasks.name: החלפת חצאים
tasks.src: l=>{ const h=Math.floor(l.length/2); return [...l.slice(h),...l.slice(0,h)]; }
tasks.note: Rotates by floor(n/2): the back part (the longer one when n is odd) moves in front of the front part.

tasks.name: האמצע
tasks.src: l=>l.length?l.slice((l.length-1)>>1,(l.length>>1)+1):[]
tasks.note: Returns the middle element for odd length, or the two middle elements for even length.

tasks.name: קרובים למינימום
tasks.src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return []; const m=Math.min(...l); return l.filter(x=>x<=m+2); }
tasks.note: Keeps elements at most 2 above the list minimum, in original order.

tasks.name: החלפת קיצוניים
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[...l]; if(r.length){ const i=r.indexOf(Math.max(...r)), j=r.indexOf(Math.min(...r)); const t=r[i]; r[i]=r[j]; r[j]=t; } return r; }
tasks.note: Swaps the positions of the maximum and the minimum; everything else stays in place.

tasks.name: ערכים שהם אינדקס
tasks.src: l=>l.filter(x=>x-8<l.length)
tasks.note: Keeps values that would be a valid index into this list when read as x-8 (that is, x-8 < length).

tasks.name: זוגיים במקום ואז האחרים
tasks.note: Unshuffle: the elements at even positions first, then the elements at odd positions.

tasks.name: הגדול מבין השניים יוצא
tasks.note: Removes whichever of the first two elements is larger; the rest stays in order.

tasks.name: רבע מכל צד
tasks.src: l=>l.slice(l.length>>2,l.length-(l.length>>2))
tasks.note: Trims floor(n/4) elements from each end by position.

tasks.name: מיון מילוני
tasks.note: Default string sort: values compare as text, so 10..15 come first and then 8, 9.

tasks.name: שכני המקסימום
tasks.src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return []; const i=l.indexOf(Math.max(...l)); return l.filter((x,j)=>Math.abs(j-i)===1); }
tasks.note: Returns the positional neighbours of the maximum (the elements just before and just after it), in order.

tasks.name: הפיכת הפנקייק
tasks.src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return []; const i=l.indexOf(Math.max(...l)); return [...l.slice(0,i+1).reverse(),...l.slice(i+1)]; }
tasks.note: Pancake flip: reverses the prefix that ends at the maximum, so the maximum comes first and the prefix is mirrored.

tasks.name: מעבר בועה אחד
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[...l]; for(let i=0;i+1<r.length;i++) if(r[i]>r[i+1]){ const t=r[i]; r[i]=r[i+1]; r[i+1]=t; } return r; }
tasks.note: One left-to-right bubble-sort pass: swaps each adjacent out-of-order pair, carrying the running maximum to the end.

tasks.name: חלוקה סביב הראשון
tasks.src: l=>l.length?[...l.filter(x=>x<l[0]),l[0],...l.filter(x=>x>l[0])]:[]
tasks.note: Quicksort partition step with the first element as pivot: smaller elements, then the pivot, then larger ones, each group in original order.

tasks.name: חלוקה לשלוש ערמות
tasks.src: l=>[0,1,2].flatMap(k=>l.filter((x,i)=>i%3===k))
tasks.note: Deals the list into three piles by position (i mod 3) and stacks pile 0, then pile 1, then pile 2.

tasks.name: כותרת חבילה
tasks.src: l=>l.length?l.slice(1,1+l[0]%4):[]
tasks.note: Packet parsing: the first element is a header whose value mod 4 says how many following elements form the payload.

tasks.name: חלון 3 הכבד
tasks.src: l=>{ if(l.length<=3) return [...l]; let b=0, bs=-1; for(let i=0;i+3<=l.length;i++){ const s=l[i]+l[i+1]+l[i+2]; if(s>bs){ bs=s; b=i; } } return l.slice(b,b+3); }
tasks.note: Returns the contiguous window of three with the largest sum (earliest on ties); lists of three or fewer are returned whole.

tasks.name: מרווח של 3 מהקודם
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[]; for(const x of l) if(!r.length||Math.abs(x-r[r.length-1])>=3) r.push(x); return r; }
tasks.note: Debounce filter: keeps an element only if it differs by at least 3 from the last element kept (the first is always kept).

tasks.name: קפיצות גדולות
tasks.src: l=>l.filter((x,i)=>i>0&&Math.abs(x-l[i-1])>=4)
tasks.note: Keeps elements that differ by at least 4 from the element just before them in the list.

tasks.name: בדרך בין השכנים
tasks.src: l=>l.filter((x,i)=>i>0&&i<l.length-1&&(l[i-1]-x)*(x-l[i+1])>0)
tasks.note: Keeps interior elements that lie strictly between their two positional neighbours (part of a rising or falling stretch).

tasks.name: זוגי ואי-זוגי לסירוגין
tasks.src: l=>{ const e=l.filter(x=>x%2===0), o=l.filter(x=>x%2===1), r=[]; for(let i=0;i<Math.max(e.length,o.length);i++){ if(i<e.length) r.push(e[i]); if(i<o.length) r.push(o[i]); } return r; }
tasks.note: Alternates the even and odd elements (even first), each kind in its original order, with leftovers appended.

tasks.name: קטן-גדול לסירוגין
tasks.src: l=>{ const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>a-b), r=[]; let i=0, j=s.length-1; while(i<=j){ r.push(s[i++]); if(i<=j) r.push(s[j--]); } return r; }
tasks.note: Min-max alternation: smallest, largest, second smallest, second largest, and so on.

tasks.name: סכום מצטבר אי-זוגי
tasks.src: l=>{ let s=0; return l.filter(x=>(s+=x)%2===1); }
tasks.note: Keeps the elements at which the running total (including the element) is odd.

tasks.name: מעקב מצביעים
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[], seen=new Set(); let i=0; while(i<l.length&&!seen.has(i)){ seen.add(i); r.push(l[i]); i=l[i]-8; } return r; }
tasks.note: Linked-list walk: starts at index 0, outputs the value, jumps to index value-8, and stops when the index is out of range or repeats.

tasks.name: הרצף המשתלם
tasks.src: l=>{ let b=0, bi=0, bj=0; for(let i=0;i<l.length;i++){ let s=0; for(let j=i;j<l.length;j++){ s+=l[j]-12; if(s>b){ b=s; bi=i; bj=j+1; } } } return l.slice(bi,bj); }
tasks.note: Maximum-subarray: the contiguous slice with the largest positive total of (x-12), earliest then shortest on ties, empty if nothing exceeds 12.

tasks.name: בין שני הגדולים
tasks.src: l=>{ if(l.length<2) return []; const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>b-a), i=l.indexOf(s[0]), j=l.indexOf(s[1]); return l.slice(Math.min(i,j)+1,Math.max(i,j)); }
tasks.note: Returns the elements strictly between the positions of the largest and the second largest values.

tasks.name: כבר במקום
tasks.src: l=>{ const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>a-b); return l.filter((x,i)=>x===s[i]); }
tasks.note: Keeps the elements that already sit where ascending sorting would put them.

tasks.name: דרגות זוגיות
tasks.src: l=>{ const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>a-b); return l.filter(x=>s.indexOf(x)%2===0); }
tasks.note: Keeps the 1st, 3rd, 5th... smallest values (even 0-based rank), output in original order.

tasks.name: עמק
tasks.src: l=>{ const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>a-b), r=[]; s.forEach((x,i)=>{ if(i%2) r.unshift(x); else r.push(x); }); return r; }
tasks.note: Valley layout: walks the sorted values and alternately appends and prepends them, so the minimum sits in the middle and values grow outward.

tasks.name: אריזה מהגדול עד 40
tasks.src: l=>{ let s=0; const pick=new Set(); for(const x of [...l].sort((a,b)=>b-a)) if(s+x<=40){ s+=x; pick.add(x); } return l.filter(x=>pick.has(x)); }
tasks.note: First-fit decreasing into a capacity of 40: tries items largest first, takes each that still fits, and outputs the chosen ones in original order.

tasks.name: מילוי מיטבי של 30
tasks.src: l=>{ const n=l.length; let best=0, bm=0; for(let m=1;m<(1<<n);m++){ let s=0; for(let i=0;i<n;i++) if(m>>i&1) s+=l[i]; if(s<=30&&s>best){ best=s; bm=m; } } return l.filter((x,i)=>bm>>i&1); }
tasks.note: Exact knapsack: the subset with the largest sum not above 30 (ties go to the smallest position bitmask), in original order.

tasks.name: שני עובדים
tasks.src: l=>{ let a=0, b=0; const r=[]; for(const x of l){ if(a<=b){ a+=x; r.push(x); } else b+=x; } return r; }
tasks.note: Online load balancing: each job goes to the worker with the smaller load so far (ties to worker A); returns worker A's jobs.

tasks.name: אוכל מהקצוות
tasks.src: l=>{ let i=0, j=l.length-1, s=0; const r=[]; while(i<=j){ const x=l[i]<=l[j]?l[i]:l[j]; if(s+x>40) break; s+=x; r.push(x); if(x===l[i]) i++; else j--; } return r; }
tasks.note: Greedy from both ends: repeatedly takes the smaller of the two end elements while the total stays within 40, in pick order.

tasks.name: מיון בתקציב 3 החלפות
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[...l]; let k=3; for(let p=0;p<r.length&&k>0;p++) for(let i=0;i+1<r.length&&k>0;i++) if(r[i]>r[i+1]){ const t=r[i]; r[i]=r[i+1]; r[i+1]=t; k--; } return r; }
tasks.note: Bubble sort with a budget of three adjacent swaps, applied in normal bubble-sort order; stops when the budget runs out.
